Step 9 Five-class Soft-label Multi-channel Benchmark

Input resolution is fixed at 384 x 384. Task: original CEA 0-4 five-class. Soft labels are generated dynamically from hard labels: interior classes use 0.90 for the true class and 0.05 for each adjacent class; boundary classes use 0.90 and 0.10. ResNet50 ImageNet pretrained; AdamW lr 1e-4, weight decay 1e-4; batch 16; 50 epochs; no validation, scheduler, or early stopping. Seeds: 42, 3407, 2026. Step 8 M (White) is the Soft-label baseline and is not retrained.

Hard-label comparison status

PENDING: the corresponding external Step 6 Hard Label multi-channel results were not supplied. This report does not claim whether Soft Label improves Hard Label and does not make a final input-plus-label choice.
